setup_retry_history.time_scope: Summed setup durations overlap under two concurrent launchers; they are not wall-clock batch latency.
setup_retry_history.interpretation: All ten original setup failures are preserved; recorded zero model attempts are checked against their original summaries.

additional_setup_retry_history.interpretation: Four additional zero-call setup failures are retained separately; their replacement trials occupy the same four of ten planned target slots.

limits: Two repetitions are not controlled seeded samples; no statistical or causal conclusion.
Knowledge reads prove nonempty tool delivery, not incorporation or usefulness.
Elapsed repository wall time includes host scheduling and concurrent trial contention; it is not pure LLM latency.
CLI invocation counts do not expose internal transport retries; token figures are CLI-reported measurements.
Known token subtotals with incomplete usage are lower bounds; missing trials are never assigned zero.
Remote weights and dollar costs are unknown; source cost is separate from the target denominator.

cost_scope.interpretation: Incomplete usage is a reported lower bound, never a complete zero-cost request. Source and diagnostic costs are separate.
